title: AirGradient Greenhouse CO2 Ventilation Gap
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airgradient:sensor
| stats avg(co2_ppm) as avg_co2_ppm, max(co2_ppm) as max_co2_ppm by zone
| where avg_co2_ppm>1200 OR max_co2_ppm>1800
| sort - max_co2_ppm
description: Uses AirGradient CO2 sensors telemetry to monitor greenhouse or shed ventilation quality in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for enclosed spaces that are holding too much stale air, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest AirGradient CO2 sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Zone table of average and max CO2 levels.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates greenhouse or shed ventilation quality so you can spot enclosed spaces that are holding too much stale air before it becomes annoying.
